description: This file defines the PcbNode class and related subclasses used for parsing, representing, and manipulating PCB design data in a hierarchical node structure. It includes methods for reading from and writing to files, parsing textual content, and constructing various node types related to PCB layout components.

classes.name: PcbNode
classes.description: Represents a generic node within a PCB design structure, capable of parsing and serialization, and serving as a base for specific node subclasses.

classes.name: SegmentNode
classes.description: A specialized subclass of PcbNode representing a 'segment' element in the PCB data.

classes.name: PadNode
classes.description: A specialized subclass of PcbNode representing a 'pad' element, with parsing capabilities.

classes.name: NetNode
classes.description: A specialized subclass of PcbNode representing a 'net' element.

classes.name: AddNetNode
classes.description: Represents an 'add_net' node type, extending PcbNode.

classes.name: GrLineNode
classes.description: Represents a 'gr_line' element in the PCB hierarchy.

classes.name: LayerNode
classes.description: Represents a 'layer' element within PCB data.

classes.name: ModuleNode
classes.description: Represents a 'module' element in the PCB structure.

classes.name: PointNode
classes.description: Represents coordinate or 'start'/'end'/'at' points within nodes.

methods.name: readFromFile
methods.description: Static method to read and parse a PCB node structure from a given file.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides Object.toString to provide a textual representation of the node.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Recursive method to parse textual PCB node data into node objects.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the node and its children into a string suitable for writing to a file.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Outputs the serialized node data to a specified file.

methods.name: setDouble
methods.description: Sets a child's value at a specified index as a double.

methods.name: asDouble
methods.description: Retrieves a child's value at a specified index as a double.

methods.name: hasChild
methods.description: Checks if the node has a child with a specified key.

methods.name: findIfExists
methods.description: Finds a child node with a specified key if it exists, otherwise returns null.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds and returns a unique child node with a specified key; throws if multiple found.

methods.name: nodes
methods.description: Returns a list of child nodes.

methods.name: iterate
methods.description: Returns all child nodes matching a specified key.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of children.

methods.name: getChild
methods.description: Retrieves a child's string value at a specified index.

methods.name: setString
methods.description: Sets a child's value at a specified index as a string.

methods.name: setInt
methods.description: Sets a child's value at a specified index as an integer.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Placeholder method to determine if a point is connected; currently always returns false.
